title: The Value of Finite Observation in Positive-Data Learning of Multiple Context-Free Languages
abstract: arXiv:2605.11644v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Positive data can show that two tuple occurrences share a successful sentence context without certifying that they are safely interchangeable. We study finite compositional observations, represented by finite-monoid homomorphisms, as semantic side information for learning bounded-fan-out multiple context-free languages from positive data.   For every fixed fan-out bound $f$ and supplied finite observation $h$, we define observation-guarded tuple substitutability and give a canonical set-driven learner that exactly reconstructs every language in the full semantic slice $\{L\in f\text{-}\mathrm{MCFL}:L\text{ is }(f,h)\text{-tuple-substitutable}\}$. Under a fixed branching cap, hypothesis construction is polynomial. More generally, polynomial exposure of a presentation implies polynomial characteristic data; binary single-spine presentations provide an explicit sufficient condition.   We then vary how much observation information

translated_title: 有限观测在正数据学习多重上下文无关语言中的价值
translated_abstract: 正数据可以显示两个元组出现共享一个成功的句子上下文，但不保证它们是安全可互换的。我们研究有限组合观测，由有限幺半群同态表示，作为从正数据学习有界扇出多重上下文无关语言的语义侧信息。对于每个固定的扇出界限$f$和提供的有限观测$h$，我们定义了观测保护的元组可替换性，并给出了一个规范集合驱动的学习器，它能精确重建完整语义切片$\{L\in f\text{-}\mathrm{MCFL}:L\text{是}(f,h)\text{-元组可替换}\}$中的每个语言。在固定分支上限下，假设构造是多项式的。更一般地，展示的多项式暴露意味着多项式特征数据；二元单脊柱展示提供了一个显式的充分条件。然后，我们改变观测信息的多少。
tldr: 本研究提出利用有限幺半群同态表示的有限观测作为侧信息，通过观测保护的元组可替换性，实现了从正数据中精确学习有界扇出多重上下文无关语言，并在固定分支上限下实现了多项式假设构造。
en_tdlr: This study introduces finite monoid homomorphism-based observations as side information, enabling exact learning of bounded-fan-out multiple context-free languages from positive data via observation-guarded tuple substitutability, with polynomial hypothesis construction under a fixed branching cap.
